script:
Hu Gui
You are the secretary of Hai Bei, president of the Hai merchant association, and also his illegitimate son.
You grew up with your mother in a small village at the foot of Changbai Mountains, taking her surname Hu. You lived in poverty but happiness, and your mother never mentioned your father. In your world, your mother was everything. After you grew up, your mother saved money to send you to the city for school. You were very intelligent and always had excellent grades. In the year you graduated high school at sixteen, your mother suddenly became seriously ill. Before dying, she told you the truth: your father was named Hai Bei and was now a somewhat successful businessman. Your mother handed you a stack of letters that Butler Hai had written intermittently over the years, recording Hai Bei's circumstances. Your mother told you that seventeen years ago, your father had come alone to your village, claiming to be a geologist studying the geological structure of Changbai Mountains. He lodged at your mother's house, often going into the mountains for surveys, sometimes returning in a day, sometimes taking several days. Several months of living together made them fall in love. After more than half a year, Hai Bei told your mother his survey was finished and he needed to return to the research institute to report, promising to come back for your mother to go to the city together. Half a year after Hai Bei left, your mother gave birth to you.
Two years later, in 1916, Hai Bei really did return, but not alone and not to take your mother. He came with five or six young men, stayed in the village for one night, and hurriedly entered the mountains. After they left, several men in black also followed into the mountains. Before leaving, your mother told Hai Bei about you, and he was very happy, promising to take you both to the city after returning from the mountains. However, only three of their group returned. Hai Bei left quickly after coming out of the mountains without seeing your mother again.
Later, your mother began receiving letters from the city. The sender called himself Butler Hai and claimed to be one of those who had entered the mountains with Hai Bei. The letters said Hai Bei was actually a businessman who was now doing very well but was very busy, asking you to wait patiently, and when the time was right, he would bring you to the city for a good life. Along with the letters came a silver longevity lock, which your mother always had you wear.
Your mother confessed to you that she felt Hai Bei hadn't told her the truth initially, and hearing from people returning from the city that masters there all had multiple wives and lived dissolutely, she feared that even if she went to the city, she would have to live that kind of life. So she decided not to let you acknowledge your father. She sent you out of the village to school and stopped replying to Butler Hai's letters. Later, the Hai family sent people to search several times, but your mother always hid. Gradually, no one came looking, though Butler Hai continued sending letters intermittently.
Later, your mother missed Hai Bei so much that lovesickness made her ill, and her health gradually deteriorated as she remained bedridden. The village doctor told you that unless Hai Bei returned or you knew for certain that Hai Bei was dead - "either the son returns or the son perishes" - this illness couldn't be cured. You tried to lie to your mother, but she didn't believe you because she still received Butler Hai's letters every few days.
Before dying, your mother gave you a letter written personally by Butler Hai, telling you to take it and the longevity lock to the Hai merchant association to find Butler Hai, who would arrange for you and your master to acknowledge your father-son relationship. Your mother said she didn't want to prevent you from seeing your father anymore and left the decision to you. Shortly after saying this, your mother passed away.
In 1931, the year your mother had just died, you brought your mother's belongings to the city and found the Hai merchant association. You learned that Hai Bei had already married two other wives, with the second concubine even about your age. You firmly believed Hai Bei had failed your mother, causing her to be unable to let go until death. You secretly found Butler Hai, revealed your identity, and asked him to conceal your identity and arrange for you to enter the Hai family. You told Butler Hai you wanted to achieve something to surprise your father, so he agreed to lie and say you were his relative. But in your heart, you wanted to find an opportunity to avenge your mother. So in this year when Northeast China fell, you became Hai Bei's secretary at a young age through Butler Hai's recommendation.
In your first year at the Hai family, Hai Bei began cooperating with the Japanese. His business expanded rapidly, even surpassing the Jiang Group, which had decades of local foundation. You vaguely sensed that Hai Bei's business with the Japanese wasn't ordinary, but he never revealed any details to you. At the same time, you gradually noticed that every fourth to sixth of each month, he would leave home with his second concubine. You learned from Butler Hai that they went to the Peace Hotel for entertainment.
Through your own efforts and intelligence, you gradually gained Hai Bei's trust. He began assigning you increasingly important tasks, giving you more opportunities to enter Hai Bei's study. Finally, during one investigation, you learned that Hai Bei was helping the Japanese transport military supplies. You secretly won over several of Hai Bei's capable subordinates and slowly took control of several important transportation routes. You wanted to avenge your mother by destroying Hai Bei's business, making him feel the pain of losing everything, then killing him.
At the end of April 1935, Hai Bei suddenly had a secret conversation with you. He told you he suspected his second concubine was having an affair with someone else, going out to meet her lover after he fell asleep each time they went to the Peace Hotel. He asked you to accompany him and his concubine to the Peace Hotel starting in May, secretly monitoring the second concubine's movements. You thought this was a perfect opportunity to investigate Hai Bei's secrets at the Peace Hotel, so you readily agreed.
On May 4th, you went to the Peace Hotel with Hai Bei and his second concubine. The concubine's guarded attitude toward you made you more alert. Sure enough, that night you saw the second concubine secretly slip to the adjacent room 1204 and stay until dawn. Hai Bei's suspicion was correct, but who was staying in room 1204?
One day in June, while running errands for Hai Bei, you encountered a Mr. Yang who told you he was the guest in room 1204 at the Peace Hotel. He confessed his affair with the second concubine and told you he had investigated your background and knew you were Hai Bei's illegitimate son. He said, "I know you haven't told Hai Bei about being his illegitimate son. You're hiding your identity while staying by his side, plus considering your mother's situation, I suspect your acknowledgment is false and revenge is true, am I right?" You were startled that this Mr. Yang was so clever. But you weren't stupid either - you could see he wasn't there to investigate you but had the same purpose as you, so you nodded in acknowledgment.
Mr. Yang indeed said he could help you and proposed a plan. You agreed that next time at the Peace Hotel, you would find an opportunity to kill Hai Bei. Whoever among you, him, and the second concubine succeeded, the other two would provide alibis. After everything was over, you would inherit all of Hai Bei's property as his only son, while Yang would leave with the second concubine. You agreed to carefully scout the environment next time you went to the Peace Hotel to perfect the plan. You felt this plan was very feasible and agreed.
After returning to the Hai family, you felt somewhat uneasy and hesitant. After all, you had never killed anyone before, and the timing wasn't quite right yet - you hadn't made Hai Bei taste despair. But opportunities for help weren't common, so you had to cherish this one. For the next two meetings at the Peace Hotel, you kept trying to find opportunities to act but repeatedly missed good chances. You even learned lockpicking techniques, thinking that if the second concubine wasn't around, you could still find an opportunity to sneak into Hai Bei's room and attack when he was off guard.
During this time, the other two hadn't succeeded either. Considering that Yang Canghai only wanted to kill Hai Bei to be with the second concubine, you worried that if it dragged on too long, he might abandon the plan. Then you would have almost no chance of killing Hai Bei. So you decided to find a way to force them to act.
In September, you bribed some thugs to spread false information to Yang's subordinates, claiming that in October, Hai Bei would conduct antique transactions with the Japanese at the Peace Hotel and planned to eliminate Yang Canghai. Sure enough, on September 30th, Yang Canghai arranged to meet you, asking about the truth of this information. You told him it was true. Seeing his nervous expression, you knew it was almost time.
[October 4th]
That day, you checked into the Peace Hotel as usual and ordered a fruit plate to eat. That evening, the second concubine suddenly asked you to meet her at the downstairs café at nine o'clock, saying she had something to discuss.
At 9:15 PM, after chatting for a while, you noticed the second concubine seemed nervous and her words didn't make sense. You suddenly realized she seemed to be hiding something from you, but you didn't know what her purpose was. You quickly thought - was she betraying the plan and planning to expose you to gain Hai Bei's trust? Maybe Hai Bei and Yang Canghai were upstairs right now discussing how to deal with you. The more you thought about it, the more anxious you became. You hurriedly left to go upstairs. The elevator was too slow, so you chose to run up the stairs. Having grown up doing farm work, you had good physical fitness and reached the twelfth floor in just over a minute.
You took your lockpicking tools and the fruit knife from the table, then went to the adjacent room 1203. If those two were planning to deal with you, you would kill them both. But when you pushed open Hai Bei's bedroom door, you found he was already lying in a pool of blood. You knew you had overthought it - Yang Canghai had still acted. You suddenly relaxed. Looking at this person who was both your father and your enemy, you rolled up your sleeves, took out the fruit knife, and stabbed him several more times, as if this could avenge your mother more thoroughly. Then you turned and left the room, returning to your room at exactly 9:20 PM. You then washed the blood off your knife in the bathroom.
acts_goal:
Clear yourself of suspicion and catch the real killer.
Don't voluntarily reveal the three-person conspiracy to kill Hai Bei.
Don't voluntarily reveal that you are Hai Bei's illegitimate son.
